title: Biblical Concordance Inverted Index
description: Corpus-wide concordance mapping lexeme IDs to total frequencies, per-book distribution counts, reference strings, and verse node IDs.

total.description: Total corpus occurrences of this lexeme.

bookcounts.description: Mapping of book abbreviation/node to count of occurrences in that book.

refs.description: List of verse reference strings where this lexeme occurs (e.g. 'Gen 1:1').

nodes.description: List of verse node IDs where this lexeme occurs.
